result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but there is one clear content bug: an untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' is displayed as a section heading instead of the actual translated title. Other observations are minor cosmetic/truncation issues.

issues.description: The section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable translated title (e.g. 'Popular near you'). This indicates a missing translation string or a failed i18n lookup.
issues.suggestion: Add the proper translation for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key in the localization files and ensure the i18n fallback resolves to a readable string rather than the raw key.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge with the name truncated mid-word and no visible scroll affordance or padding.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a peek/fade indicator so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable, and ensure card titles truncate gracefully with an ellipsis.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a red badge dot but no visible text label or apparent accessible name, which may be unclear to screen-reader users.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g. aria-label='Notifications') and consider a text or count indicator for the badge.
